name: boss-7
about: Boss Rush: Longevity Lich, second version (2026-11-16): an ancient clockwork lich: a cracked white porcelain mask with mint eye slits, a crown of clock hands, a glass case in its chest holding a glowing hourglass, a high-collared teal and gold brocade robe open over thin brass legs, brass clockwork fingers. The first version (boss-7-v1.json), a crowned chrome skeleton, read as the stock skeleton king and too like the Patrimony Phantom. Tripo H3.1 from concept boss07b-lich-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, bound to the bones that own them; the robe in bands.
